rows.summary: This journal focuses on the architectural separation of cognition, control, and memory to improve decision fidelity in agent systems, as explored in the notebook on reasoning transparency. Research continues to evaluate how these structural changes reduce unsupported assertions, independent of prompt-based baseline performance. We are complying with the Attention constraint by parking the Foundational Axiom project to manage system capacity while focusing on verified architectural outcomes.
